title: Battle of Imbituba
text: The Battle of Imbituba was a naval battle between the rebel Juliana Republic and the Empire of Brazil during the Ragamuffin War, taking place on 4 November 1839 in Imbituba in Santa Catarina. The rebel flotilla was forced to withdraw by the superior Imperial flotilla, setting one of its own ships on fire and leaving while the Imperials were distracted.
